project.name: principia-physica-pilot
project.link_source: website/.vercel/project.json copied into the release checkout; the checkout itself excludes .vercel and .env* from source control

deployment.url_source: Captured verbatim from the vercel deploy --prod JSON output and its 'Aliased' line; confirmed independently by vercel inspect, which lists https://principia-physica-pilot.vercel.app among this deployment's aliases. No URL was guessed or constructed.

linked_asset_check.method: curl per path, HTTP status recorded, body hashed with shasum -a 256 and compared byte for byte against website/<path>
linked_asset_check.note: The listed paths are the 20 distinct linked targets; styles.css is referenced once by the stylesheet link and og.png once by the Open Graph meta, giving 21 asset requests plus the document itself for a total of 22 validated production URLs.

deployment_layout_check.finding_addressed: reviews/website-review.json required that the deployed layout be checked because the earlier page used ../papers/... references that escape the web root.
deployment_layout_check.result: The published index.html contains no parent-escaping reference; every paper, formal, review, and receipt target resolves inside the deployed root and returns 200.
